isbns.title: ISBNs
isbns.description: ISBN-10 or ISBN-13, one per line. Dashes and spaces are fine. Each ISBN returns exactly the matching book.

queries.title: Title or author searches
queries.description: Free text searches like a book title, an author, or both ("things fall apart achebe"). Each search returns the best matches.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Matches per search
maxResultsPerQuery.description: How many best matches to return for each title or author search. ISBNs always return one.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
